p: Grave of the last Grand Duchess of Russia
Grand Duchess Olga Alexandrovna was the younger sister of Tsar Nicholas II, the last tsar of Russia. After World War II, she lived in Canada and died in Toronto in 1960.
There are goldfish in the pond. The path on the south side passes through a rustic cluster of trees.
Many of the grave monuments carry a Chinese theme including a grave with 2 pagoda-style gazebos.
